description: Isolated temporary rope-and-post safety barrier for the existing natural cave entrance; the cave itself is retained unchanged.
generation_notes: Initial imagegen created exactly two short weathered wooden stakes connected by one sagging hemp rope, isolated on transparent background. Cave crop was supplied for palette and perspective reference only.

A second imagegen edit preserved the barrier and added a small plain wooden notice plaque hanging from the middle of the rope. Its strokes suggest a notice; all readable dialogue is supplied by the interaction.

The source crop encloses all prop pixels with alpha greater than one. Export crops and resizes only, then registers the native transparent image without painting the retained ground or any existing scene image.
